items.title: Stocks mostly rise tracking earnings, US-Iran hopes
items.summary: Stock markets mostly climbed on Wednesday as investors digested a wave of company earnings that have broadly surpassed expectations, while assessing the chances of a US-Iran deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. His comments to Fox News came as Axios reported that the United States, Iran and Oman were nearing an interim deal to reopen the strait, which Washington was hoping to announce Wednesday.
